maria: traces show KV cache miss rate spiked ~2x at 1901234400. lots of cold prefix misses, eviction churn.

ops-bot: k8s events: node-group-eu capacity at 92%, 2 inference pods Pending for 3m. cmd: `kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | grep Pending`

ashwin: also toggling route config to reduce batch size: lowering `max_batch_tokens` for model-swap route to cut tail latency.

sara: PD shows escalation to secondary. @jake heads-up on escalation.
ashwin: temporarily enable routing policy -> fallback to `model-variant-legacy` for heavy throughput customers in eu-west to stabilize latency.
incident-bot: Automatic fallback policy activated for route inference->legacy; 12% of traffic rerouted as a mitigation.

maria: p95 trending down: 500ms -> 320ms over last 3 minutes. p99 still ~900ms. good sign but still above SLO for some keys.
sara: customer impact: degraded latency for a small subset (high-throughput customers). No errors or data loss reported. CS notified to prepare messaging.
ashwin: creating an incident ticket / doc: suspected root causes = KV eviction spike + autoscaler capacity gap after model-swap. Will document timeline and mitigation.
incident-bot: PD12345 update: acknowledged by ashwin; escalated to oncall-2 (jake).
maria: handing off to jake for longer monitoring and follow-up RCA. please keep PD open until p99 < 500ms for 15m. :thumbsup:
jake: taking handoff. I'll keep watch, will rollback to stable model if p99 goes >1s again. rollback path: `/deployments/rollbacks/stable-model` — updating runbook now.
